title: Elytra - Just Craft It!
description: Craftable Elytra - Adds a fairly difficult crafting recipe for the Elytra.
body:
Need an Elytra so bad, but can't beat the Ender Dragon? 

Worry no more! 

**Elytra - Just Craft It!** is the first mod/datapack in the Just Craft It! series.

Instead of beating the Dragon to explore the outer islands in search of an Elytra. You can just craft one using a few simple ingredients. 

Forget the Dragon, just defeat two phantoms, collect their membranes and you are goof to go!
